findings.claim: Send-the-diff line vs the OpenCode no-diff line, and the Codex rule hidden behind a bare pointer. Fixed in 9553cf54: the pointer names both runtime rules.

Refusal told apart by the stderr prefix. Answered: the prefix error: review frozen-context: is pinned by the T40 command tests, and any other text still denies with the fixed sentence, so a launch is never let through.

A second hook run on the same call would expand again. Answered: OpenCode fires tool.execute.before once per call; a re-expanded brief is refused by the verb (two pairs or over the limit), which denies, never passes. Skipping on a marker would let a parent forge one.
